findings.claim: Within first-session threshold games, previous own contribution is a strong causal-input forecast that beats the tested memory and flexible controls on reserved interacting pairs.
findings.falsification: Only university-laboratory pairwise threshold games; no intervention, other populations or fixed-horizon forecasting.
findings.scope: Per-player, one-step prediction with observed prior rounds.
findings.known_prior_art: The source paper analyzes equilibrium, reciprocity, relative contributions and coordination. We compare causal forecasts beyond these mechanisms, without claiming a new universal behavioral law.

findings.claim: Uniform focal adjustment, proportional reciprocity, threshold-error adjustment, success-dependent adjustment and long-memory shrinkage do not improve over persistence in this campaign.
findings.falsification: Failure to improve prediction cannot disprove psychological motives; least-squares fitting and restricted families remain limitations.
findings.scope: Explicit tested equations and identical permitted histories.
